scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/*.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && expo install --check
scripts.build:preview:android: bash -c 'source scripts/local-tools.sh && python3 scripts/build-local.py android preview'
scripts.build:preview:ios: bash -c 'source scripts/local-tools.sh && python3 scripts/build-local.py ios preview'
scripts.build:production: npm run check && npm run build:production:android && npm run build:production:ios
scripts.build:production:ios: bash -c 'source scripts/local-tools.sh && python3 scripts/build-local.py ios production'
scripts.build:production:android: bash -c 'source scripts/local-tools.sh && python3 scripts/build-local.py android production'
